posts.title: First Cattiversary!
posts.description: It's one year today since Ciri and Myshka came home. They are the silliest, weirdest little creatures I have ever had the good fortune to meet and every day, I've been grateful that they're a part of my life. Slightly less grateful when Myshka decided that my bed at 3am was the best place to "play" with the giant spider he'd half-eaten but other than that, much gratitude. Tomorrow is my birthday,
